name: Single-Arm Row (Cable)
instructions: Sit or stand at a cable station, holding a single handle.
Row the handle to your torso, driving the elbow back past your side.
Squeeze the lat hard at full contraction.
Extend slowly. The cable keeps constant tension on the back.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner cable pull-pattern exercise for the lats. Single-Arm Row (Cable) strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
